letter.title: Our letter to you
paragraphs: To the people who carried us through every season of this life — thank you. 🌟 You showed up on the ordinary Tuesdays, not just the beautiful days. You celebrated our small wins like they were your own, and you held space for our heartbreaks without ever making us feel like a burden. 👋

This journey of ours would have been a very lonely road without you in it. Every milestone we reached, we reached because someone was cheering louder than the voice of our own doubt. You believed in us before we believed in ourselves, and that kind of love is the rarest thing in the world. 💖❤️

So on our wedding day, we are not just celebrating our union — we are celebrating you. Everyone who travelled in the rain, who wiped away our tears, who made us laugh until our stomachs hurt, who taught us what it means to build a home out of a group of people who choose each other every day. 🎉
Thank you for being our safe place, our cheerleaders, our forever friends. We love you more than words on any page could hold — but we are going to try anyway. 🗫 🌏
